summary: Completed backend+frontend Theatre redesign verification on preview URL with authenticated live-editor checks, responsive coverage, SSR checks, media integrity validation against supplied assets, and DB safety comparison against theatre-reference backup.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent panel reopen failure after reload while dock remains active; clicking live-editor-toggle can leave no panel visible, blocking continued UI restoration flow.

action_items: Investigate LiveEditorProvider toggle logic/state race after reload when sessionStorage keeps editor active but panel is not mounted.
Main agent should self-retest editor reopen + discard/undo path on theatre after page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Live-editor toggle relies on DOM query for panel readiness; if 'on' is true and panel missing, repeated toggle may not recover panel state reliably.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theatre content was mutated during UI tests and restored to redesigned baseline via authenticated /api/admin/pages/theatre/live save using theatre_reference copy. Verified no T1 markers remain. DB comparison vs /app/memory/backups/theatre-reference-2026-10-16.json: non-theatre pages unchanged, all original theatre section IDs retained, notes_feed retained hidden, one new connect ID, draft+published each have 7 sections, design_migration remains theatre-reference-2026-10-16. apply_theatre_reference.py rerun returns no-op message.
rca of the issue: Observed twice in Playwright: after reload with live-editor dock visible, waiting for [data-testid=live-editor-panel] timed out after toggle click. Likely state mismatch between active/sessionStorage and panel mount readiness check in toggle handler (depends on document.querySelector('[data-live-panel-ready="true"]')).
